title: The Midnight Ledger
introduction: Rain hammers the precinct windows as Captain Hale slides a thin case file across your desk. A financier was found dead in a locked study, and every suspect has an alibi written in ink.
resolution: The ledger proves the financier discovered a forgery ring inside his own firm. The killer staged the scene to look like a robbery, but the weapon and location tell the truth.

clues.hint: The body was discovered where contracts are signed and secrets stay behind oak doors.
clues.reaction: The study was locked from the inside, yet the ledger shows a meeting scheduled minutes before the murder.
clues.investigatePrompt: Search the crime scene for a five-letter location.

clues.hint: The coroner found a narrow puncture wound, clean and precise.
clues.reaction: A kitchen knife is missing from the manor's silver set, and the handle was wiped clean.

clues.hint: The partner stood to inherit control of the firm if the victim disappeared.
clues.reaction: The heir's fingerprints were on the ledger, and their alibi collapses under cross-examination.
